summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of MyExtension Business (Pilotage/Vision/Bien-être + Kairos AI). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (seed, KPIs recompute on facture add/delete, full CRUD for factures/depenses/objectifs/rituels/humeur, vision set/persist, rituel toggle+streak, Kairos streaming chat + history). Frontend: All critical UI flows work — KPI cards render, evolution chart displays, add/delete facture updates list, add depense works, Vision text edit+save persists, add/edit/delete objectif works, check-in updates energy gauge to submitted value, rituel add/toggle/delete works, affirmation cycles, sidebar nav switches all 3 pages, Kairos panel streams a French response (verified: 'Relance aujourd'hui tes 3 200 € de factures en retard...'). No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Streak logic increments on toggle-on but does NOT decrement on toggle-off (see server.py L245: streak += 1 if new_done else -1 if doc.done else 0). Since doc.done was True when toggling off, streak decrements. But then future toggle-on adds +1 again → potentially double-counts. Consider spec review: normally streak should only accumulate consecutive days, not toggle.

issues: React a11y console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent. Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription to each Dialog to remove a11y warnings.
(Optional) Review rituel streak semantics — currently toggling off decrements streak (could yield unexpected behavior on toggle churn).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] directly (good, fails fast). ObjectId is properly excluded via {"_id": 0} projection everywhere.

streamKairos in api.js does not handle non-200 response — if backend errors out with 4xx/5xx, res.body.getReader() will still attempt to read, causing confusing errors. Consider adding `if (!res.ok) throw...`
Pilotage buildTrend() uses Math.sin with no seed → chart shape stable per render but not tied to real historical data (as documented, synthetic).
Rituel toggle streak calculation is questionable (see backend minor issue above).
seed_data_creation: Backend /api/seed was called by both pytest fixture and UI. Test-created data with UI_TEST_ prefix was cleaned up in Playwright script. One UI_TEST_Dep depense may remain (added during checkin gauge failed-then-retried run) — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run with `pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` — do NOT use pytest-xdist parallel mode as seed fixture races cause KPI assertion failures (workers reseed independently). All 10 tests pass sequentially. Kairos streaming via emergentintegrations gpt-5.4 confirmed working, response takes ~5-10s. Frontend fully functional at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Note the nav testid uses accents: `nav-bien-être` (must use locator, not selector string with quotes).
